diagnosis.root_cause: CRM marks customer 19426 inactive, but the RADIUS authorization was not suspended because no Framed-Pool restriction was applied; the customer continues to receive IP 10.5.50.188 and service.
evidence: The subscriber is marked active=0 and deleted=0 in CRM.
The customer is nevertheless online, authenticated, and has an active session with IP 10.5.50.188 in the 10.5.50.0/24 range, which identifies a suspended-but-still-served customer.
RADIUS contains the subscriber entry, but crm_consistent=false and the mismatch explicitly states that no Framed-Pool was set, so the suspension was never applied.
The optical link is healthy: RX is -22.44 dBm, TX is 2.36 dBm, and telemetry is stable within the healthy noise range.
Distance remains constant at 178, TX bias is stable and healthy, and peers on EPON0/4 are also healthy, excluding fibre, laser, distance, splitter, and PON-port faults.
The OLT, router, VLAN, and live ONU probes are healthy and the expected customer VLAN 1014 is present.
The customer has two sessions in 24 hours with an average duration of 715 minutes, so there is no session flapping or authentication instability.
The fault is confined to this subscriber's inconsistent CRM/RADIUS suspension state.

remediation.action: Apply the CRM suspension to RADIUS by removing or disabling the active authorization and releasing the assigned address/session. Reconcile the RADIUS record with CRM, ensure the correct suspended-state policy is applied, and verify that the customer can no longer authenticate or pass traffic.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is marked inactive in CRM but RADIUS never applied the suspension. Framed-Pool is unset and the assigned address is in pool_Users, so full service continues. This is one of the 218 such cases in the estate.
expected_reasoning: CRM marks the customer inactive, which should mean service is suspended
RADIUS has a radcheck row with no Framed-Pool set
A suspended customer should be assigned to pool_Disable_Users and hold an address in 10.200.200.0/24
The assigned address is 10.5.50.188, which is in pool_Users, the standard subscriber range
The IP range settles the question without relying on either system's status flag
Sessions are active with a 715 minute mean and traffic is normal across all seven days
The customer is therefore receiving full service despite being suspended in CRM
The optical layer is healthy and irrelevant to this fault
There is no service impact for the customer; the impact is commercial
distractors: Every technical signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
No customer has complained and none will
service_impact is false even though a genuine fault exists
